decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that remained on its own product page in both 2023 and 2024, it appears closely related to the firm's existing finishing know-how and has likely been sufficiently assimilated into the portfolio to justify continued support.

The folding add-on unit fits the firm's established print-finishing competence and the named customer installation gives usable market feedback and learning effects, though its lighter website presence makes it slightly more vulnerable than C.
